_doc: Delta Face terrain levels (SLICE3; agent 2026-11-16: 'Delta Face is not flat'). Read by citylib/terrain.py through delta_face.json 'levels_file'. 'datum' overrides layout.Heights (metres above mean sea level). 'areas' offset the ground surfaces (pavements, lawns, plots; never the carriageway) by dz from the plot datum (road + kerb = 3.95 m): ramp_m > 0 ramps smoothly back to the datum outside the polygon, ramp_m = 0 is a hard step with a wall face (edge 'terrace' = white render, 'retaining' = rubble stone). Areas apply in file order; the first one wins where they overlap. Polygons are in the named hero's own frame (u along the north wing, v across it) or 'world'. Every height is an ESTIMATE from the photos (scale from people, cars, kerbs, steps and balustrades) until a survey or DEM replaces it.

_sources.road: Delta Face is low ground: the carriageway about 3-4 m above mean sea level; kept from V1 (ESTIMATE, no survey).
_sources.kerb: agent h08, h16, gf_22: the granite kerb about a hand-span high next to a car wheel (ESTIMATE 0.15 m).
_sources.promenade_step: HEIGHTS 2026-11-24 (ESTIMATE): promenade below the PLOT datum = the Green's 0.3 m below the roadside pavement (layer_levels delta_face_green_sunk) + gf_10's four ~16 cm steps from the Green down to the promenade (0.65 m); was -0.65 when the Green sat at datum. With beach_top 0.6 the seawall face is 3.95-0.95-0.6 = 2.4 m (gf_03/gf_04: 2.3-3.0 m).

step_runs._doc: P87 (citylib/level_edges.py): a stair profile swept along `line` (the top edge, world x east / y north), going down to the `down` side by `steps` treads of `tread_m`; the rise follows the terrain at the top and foot, so it lands on north_steps_foot. Cut out of the ground; risers and tread backs carry baked contact shade.

The low edge: one 0.3 m riser with a 0.3 m coping tread (ESTIMATE, tier C).

contact_shade._doc: P87 (citylib/level_edges.py, research advanced-features-plan B5): contact shade baked into COLOR_0.A where a floor meets a level edge. Floor alpha = 1 - strength * (1 - vis), vis = 0.5 * (1 + d / sqrt(d^2 + h^2)) for a point d m in front of a wall h m high; bands_m are the strip edges on the promenade (0.65 m Green wall), seawall_bands_m on the sand from the seawall toe (2.9 m; toe seawall_toe_m in front of the seawall line, KIT_Seawall_Rubble batter + toe); wall_foot_alpha on the foot corners of the retaining-wall faces. promenade_drive_m: the Delta Face Drive asphalt strip along the seawall on the promenade (DELTA_FACE_MEASURED.md layer 5: brick about 5 m, asphalt about 4 m, tier C). 0 ms on Low: PaintedLit reads COLOR_0.A through _VertexAO.
contact_shade._promenade_drive_doc: P117 / B3: 6.5 m, measured_values.json promenade.drive_asphalt_m (confidence medium-low), inside the 15.5 m promenade (promenade.seawall_to_green_m). Was 4.0.

layer_levels.name: delta_face_green_sunk
layer_levels.source: Agent r8 (2026-11-23): the Green is a few steps below the A2. measured_values.json green.road_side_drop_m 0.3 m (range 0-0.45, confidence medium; OSM 'down' steps every 75-80 m from the roadside pavement), the north_steps_foot strip and the one-riser north_edge_low step runs; 2 x 0.15 m risers. Below the road surface by 0.15 m, below the pavement by 0.3 m (ESTIMATE, no survey).

grades.name: new_baladaksha_mw
grades.source: Agent r8: Baladaksha Mawatha is not flat. Rises off the Centre Road junction, runs above the lake on its retaining edge (os_16 lake low wall), dips at the bend and climbs to the steel-railed causeway north of the Akbar oval (os_12) before falling to the oval. Max slope ~1.6% (ESTIMATE: no DEM resolves it; SRTM 30 m too coarse).

grades.source: Delta Face Centre Road crosses the Beira lake inlet on a short bridge: a hump of ~0.9 m over the 66 m span, both carriageways (ESTIMATE).
